pro_course_detail.description:

Vocabulary & Phrases: We start by exploring key vocabulary and phrases that appear in the short movie scene.
Practice Exercises: Next, we dive into two exercises to reinforce the words and phrases we’ve learned.
Conversation Time: We take a moment to chat and build confidence in using the language.

pro_course_detail.title: Journey to Romanian Fluency
pro_course_detail.description:
This course is suitable for all levels of proficiency and will focus on meeting you where you’re at and improving your command of the Romanian language based on your goals, needs, level, and preferences. Every lesson will be customized to fit your unique learning style and pace. 

If you are someone who is just starting out on their Romanian language journey, we will focus on learning the basics of the language: spelling, the alphabet (including special characters), pronunciation and distinguishing sounds, grammar, as well as beginner-level reading, writing, listening, and speaking. 

If you are an intermediate Romanian speaker who has a good command of basic Romanian grammatical structures and vocabulary, but would like to improve their language skills further, we will focus more on reading comprehension, speaking and listening practice, as well as on improving writing skills. However, we will, of course, touch on grammar, pronunciation and spelling as needed. 

If you are an advanced learner, we will concentrate on advanced grammatical structures and idioms, regional dialects depending on your needs and preferences, fluency and confidence in using your Romanian language skills.

teacher_info.teaching_style:
1. I think that communication between the student and the teacher is very important. So there is a need for a base language that both speak well, in order for concepts in the target language to be explained correctly and also to solidify the student-teacher relatuonship
2. Noticing and reinforcing certain patters that appear in language learning, eg: certain connecting words, that appear often, connecting certain word forms that share similarities based on logic, instead of just simply trying to memorize them 
3. Making use of texts and materials in a way to create an easy way for the student to come in contact with vocabulary and use it in an interactive way, to help learn new words easier
